friction_events.description: Allocator generated_at was ~2h56m older than the worker beacon commit according to GitHub server time, so recovery candidates were ineligible under the >90s stale-snapshot rule.

The two usable non-recovery candidates returned exact GitHub Contents CREATE_EXISTS collisions. Three stale recovery attempts were also made before clock reconciliation; all collided and created no authority.
The first no-allocation receipt write saw one branch-head movement and succeeded on the single bounded stabilization retry.

decision_trace.decision: Create a fresh v3.30 identity before allocation.
decision_trace.action: Created the worker beacon and froze worker_id plus launch_nonce.
decision_trace.outcome: Fresh beacon persisted at GitHub server time 2026-10-04T20:02:53Z.

decision_trace.decision: Correct allocator clock interpretation before finalizing E9.
decision_trace.observable_basis: GitHub commit server time showed claim-frontier generated_at was ~10564 seconds old, exceeding the >90s recovery eligibility limit.
decision_trace.action: Reclassified all recovery candidates as ineligible and excluded them from terminal exhaustion accounting.
decision_trace.outcome: Only ready + role_ready remain usable; both had already returned CREATE_EXISTS.

decision_trace.decision: Close at E2 rather than fabricate work below the residency target.
decision_trace.observable_basis: No usable non-recovery candidate remained on the allocator surface; stale recovery was contract-ineligible.
decision_trace.action: Updated the no-allocation receipt and terminal exam with corrected stale-frontier accounting.
decision_trace.outcome: Truthful terminal NO_ALLOCATION boundary with zero productive units and explicit protocol deviation record.

top_time_sinks.note: Repeated atomic claim races consumed the useful launch window.

unfinished_debt.item: No productive unit was assigned in this launch because the fresh claimable frontier was fully occupied.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Ensure claim-frontier freshness timestamps use the same UTC basis as GitHub server time and refresh the public allocator surface before recovery routing.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Prevent stale recovery attempts and reduce collision-only fresh-worker launches.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 BATCH worker created successfully. GitHub server time proved the allocator projection was ~2h56m stale. The two usable non-recovery candidates were both already owned; three stale recovery paths had also been attempted in error but all returned CREATE_EXISTS, creating no authority. The corrected terminal record is NO_ALLOCATION with zero productive units.
